notes.title: The Rusty Longsword will be Free to Play!
notes.notes: After much throwing around of the idea, the studio head has decided to make Sapling Studios' The Rusty Longsword free for everone to play! We hope you new players enjoy the vibes and love put into the title!

notes.title: The Rusty Longsword Midnight Update!
notes.notes: To Celebrate our partnership with Midnight Studios in porting The Rusty Longsword to Xbox Series X/S, Playstation 4/5 and Nintendo Switch we've gone through the game, fixing common issues, Revamping entire story sections, and adding even more vistas to appreciate! We hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: Update Notes for Dec 10
notes.notes:
- Sheriff Dialog Fixed
- Night 3 intro now plays

notes.title: Rusty Longsword Released Today!
notes.notes: The Rusty Longsword is available for purchase today! This project has been a long time coming for me, it's ready to play but I'll be rolling out patches for the first month! So get involved in the community, post bugs you might have seen or even stuff you'd like to see! Maybe I'll add it!
